comparedWithPreviousPackage.note: Added and removed are renamed content-hashed bundle chunks, the guide and the activator under its own name; changed are the bundles' manifests, the offline shell and its manifest, the service worker, the sums and the guide. No file of node_modules is touched.

tests/app-browser-workflows.mjs.reason: Reaches the permission-denial step: Chromium started through Playwright does not apply the browser permission override in this context (expected denied, got granted). The unmodified baseline fails at the same step with the same message.

tests/competitor-intelligence-browser.mj.reasonInFullRun: the native-app emulator now answers dictation itself (speechProtocol 1), so the test's mocked browser recognition was never used; the test now announces an app without the speech service

tests/erp-sales-browser.mjs.reason: Needs the original ERP workbook (ENOENT /home/upload/Reports_Invoices_14480422_094904.xlsx); it was never supplied. The unmodified baseline fails identically.

tests/location-picker-browser.mjs.reasonInFullRun: the city field's accessible name now carries the dictation button's label, so an exact-name lookup found nothing; the test now looks it up by the start of its name

tests/offline-browser.mjs.reason: Cold offline reload: Playwright setOffline does not cover the service worker network in this Chromium. The unmodified baseline times out at the same wait.

tests/pwa-browser.mjs.reason: Cold offline navigation uses the data-free client shell: same cause as offline-browser. The unmodified baseline fails at the same assertion.

gates.browserNotes: Four tests fail exactly as before this update, at the same step, for the same reasons (Playwright cannot deny a permission or work offline in this Chromium, and the original ERP workbook is not in the test environment). competitor-intelligence-browser and location-picker-browser failed in the full run for the two reasons given with each, both in the tests and not in the application, and pass after the test-only fix (commit 274a37a), run on the same built release.
